About

Accudyne Systems has been developing novel automation equipment and solutions to complex manufacturing challenges since 1996. Founded through the merger of two respected engineering firms in Delaware, the company is a recognized leader in the design and development of first-of-a-kind automation equipment and processes that result in dramatic production improvements over existing systems. To provide these solutions, we integrate several areas of expertise including:

  • Novel Solution Development
  • Mechanical, Electrical, and Software Engineering Design
  • Fabrication and Assembly
  • System Integration
  • Equipment Delivery, Rigging, and Startup
  • Post-Startup Support

Equipment solutions are developed through a multidisciplinary design and engineering approach executed by our engineers, designers and manufacturing associates. Our team works closely with the customer to define requirements, develop concepts, accomplish risk reduction research, and produce equipment solutions that provide our customers with reduced costs, increased quality, and strong competitive advantage. With Accudyne’s team, your project will be a success. Our most valuable product is the solution to your needs.

In the area of machines for the automation of composite part manufacturing, Accudyne Systems, Inc. uses a “Part Purpose” approach to abstracting a solution. It entails a thorough engineering analysis of the composite part and current manufacturing process(es) followed by the development of an automation solution using our 7 step process that is tailored to manufacturing that specific part or family parts.

Our customers include entrepreneurial startups, small businesses, and venerable Fortune 500 companies. Our successes have brought great value and success to our customers and is evidenced by our ‘trusted advisor’ status to several customer organizations across all of the markets we serve.
